Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES
PR: #254
Head: 92ce1171412a8555d986246e188b158430238e8f
Request: 01a1f1ee-a8b9-72a2-a5be-12b484bff590

No security vulnerabilities found in the complete public diff and PR body, including the upstream-issue facts. No credential reads/logging, tokens, account/tenant identifiers, enterprise hostnames, or non-layout private machine paths were found. Review applies C33's same-user trust boundary; it does not claim per-seat isolation.

Authority and destructive-operation brakes:
- crates/daemon/src/http/auth_error.rs:19-62 uses a closed payload, requires a native session, binds the seat through bound_seat and requires Copilot. Existing binding rejects tombstoned seats and contradictory session evidence (crates/daemon/src/http/fyi.rs:379-492). Existing bearer authentication and default-denied peer scope remain in force (crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:475-484,787-819).
- crates/core/src/control.rs:61-99 permits manual restart only for Copilot and only for self or the recorded parent. The HTTP control path derives the actor from its pane, refuses contradictory claims and checks the recorded process before authorization (crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:2631-2686). No new authority-laundering path was found.
- Restart shares the Copilot two-read settled-idle gate, not a compact-only condition (crates/daemon/src/pointer/worker.rs:379-399,465-478). Submission uses the existing interaction gate (511-560), which checks permission and empty composer again under input ownership (crates/harnesses/src/interaction.rs:631-687). The report selects the destructive restart policy; settled-idle, composer and cooldown conditions are one-directional brakes: removing them permits the same operation in more states.
- Recovery state suppresses sequential reports; a different PID after attempted recovery records relogin before notifying. Notices deduplicate recipients, exclude self/tombstones, and use the current parent and designated prime, not legacy prime assignments (crates/daemon/src/auth_recovery.rs:94-175,227-271; crates/store/src/governance.rs:675-685). This is sequential suppression, not a claim of transactional exactly-once delivery across failures.
- .copilot/extensions/pij/store.mjs:45-70,2250-2295 recognizes authorization/401 and credential-authority prefixes, coalesces until idle, and posts only seat, native_session and kind. The source error text is not forwarded.

Recovery-contract notes for the correctness owner, not security vulnerabilities:
1. The requested monotonic cooldown is not implemented. auth_error.rs:57-62 supplies UNIX wall time from http/mod.rs:4388-4404 to auth_recovery.rs:94-174. A forward clock correction can expire this brake early. Do not describe the implementation as a monotonic 30-minute guarantee.
2. The control acknowledgement confirms typing, not CLI restart success. A same-PID or unavailable /restart remains pending until expiry, when another attempt can occur; it does not take the different-PID relogin-notice branch. Do not claim confirmed restart or no retry for those cases.

The correctness reviewer independently reports these as P2 blockers in verdict aab3108: R254-001 (same-PID/unavailable restart) and R254-002 (wall-clock cooldown). This security pass-with-notes does not override that correctness BLOCK or approve merge.

Evidence and limits:
- just pr-freeze 254: PASS/FINAL immediately before publication; ls-remote and GitHub agree on the full head, base main, CLEAN merge state, clean detached worktree, latest CI checks passing. Local Delivers parsing was unavailable; pr-freeze explicitly relied on the successful CI Delivers check for this head.
- The security review inspected CI run 44453854862 at this head and its JUnit artifact: six auth-recovery tests, two new route tests, and existing control-authority/composer/idle tests passed.
- F190's actual CLI restart semantics are the PR author's reported live probe, not an independently repeated destructive probe.
- No local builds/tests, dependency installation, code changes, seat restarts or destructive endpoint probes were performed.
- No new polling loop/timer or direct daemon launch site was found; recovery uses the existing drain path. Live cost assessment belongs to the performance verdict.

Harness feedback: a CI-receipt-only checks mode would make exact-head read-only reviews provable without invoking local build/test stages. Captured as observation MW-001; no product changes requested or made here.
